meta.name: process:mail_routing
meta.description: 231 (plan stage C, C1c; DECISIONS 231): the routing of emailed documents as a process pack (until C1c its own kind of package). A case reads the email packages its scope names: every PDF attachment that arrived in them is proposed for the package of its party, period and role, and a person accepts, rejects or redirects each one; the case is done once every attachment it can route is decided. The emails that start a case of another process (an IT quote) are listed with those cases. Every step names a general capability; the pack holds no code.

changelog.note: 231 (C1c): the first version: the routing step (file_placement@1) and its tabs: Emails, Routing, Routed, Started cases, History.
